emacs:
(setq org-agenda-prefix-format '((agenda . " %-10.8:c%l%?-12t%-12s") (todo . " %-6e %T: %b") (tags . "%c/%l") (search . " %i %-12:c"))
      org-agenda-todo-keyword-format "%-4s"
      org-agenda-scheduled-leaders '("Sched: " "S.%2d: ")
      org-agenda-deadline-leaders '("Due: " "In %d: " "Late %d: ")
      org-agenda-timerange-leaders '("" "Day %d of %d: ")
      org-agenda-breadcrumbs-separator " / "
      org-agenda-remove-tags 'prefix
      org-agenda-custom-commands
      '(("b" "Breadcrumbs" agenda "" ((org-agenda-span 'day) (org-agenda-prefix-format '((agenda . "  %?-6e%b"))) (org-agenda-remove-tags t)))
        ("c" "Blocks" ((todo "" ((org-agenda-todo-keyword-format "") (org-agenda-prefix-format '((todo . "%?-5e|")))))
                       (tags-todo "home" ((org-agenda-prefix-format '((tags . "[%T] ")))))))))
